items.job: Inspect and replace brake pedal pushrod retainer
items.note: Covered by a GM safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Buick dealer.

items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant sensing pad/module
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask a Buick dealer.

items.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run
items.job: Install new key ring and key insert (ignition recall fix)
items.note: Free under GM's ignition key recall. Check your VIN or ask a Buick dealer.
Free under GM's headlamp driver module recall for affected years. Check your VIN.

items.job: Replace pistons and rings (2.4L oil consumption repair)
items.note: GM special coverage covered many 2.4L cars. Ask a dealer about the oil consumption test and check your VIN.

items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners (V6)
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the chain jumped and damaged valves or the engine.

items.t: Rear toe links rust and break
items.job: Replace both rear toe links and align
items.note: Covered by GM's toe link corrosion recall for affected cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: Power seat height bolt can fall out
items.job: Replace power seat height adjuster bolts
items.note: Free under GM's seat bolt recall. Check your VIN or ask a Buick dealer.

items.job: Test and replace eAssist generator control module
items.note: Dealers test and replace the module free under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Wrong brake rotors on the front
items.job: Replace front brake rotors with correct parts
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected 2014 cars. Check your VIN.
Free software update under GM's airbag recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Water can get into power steering connectors
items.job: Inspect and reseal power steering motor connectors
items.note: Covered by a GM recall. If the steering gear is damaged, more parts may be needed. Check your VIN.

items.job: Reinstall or replace rear toe links and align
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected 2017 cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear brake caliper pistons can corrode
items.job: Replace both rear brake calipers and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask a Buick dealer.

items.t: Start/stop accumulator cover can leak fluid
items.job: Replace start/stop accumulator cover and bolts, top off fluid
items.note: Free under GM's accumulator recall. Cost rises if the transmission was damaged by low fluid.

items.t: Engine can stall without warning while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace the failed sensor or fuel pump

items.t: Power steering assist can quit while driving
items.job: Replace electric power steering motor and control unit

items.t: Airbag system can be disabled by an electrical fault (recall)
items.job: Repair restraint system wiring or replace airbag control module
items.note: Free under recall 14V-355. Check the VIN first.
